summary: Development-only defined-behavior source pilot:16 candidate semantic mutations plus unchanged, cosmetic, added and removed interfaces. No target execution. All authored labels require independent binary survival review; no held-out accuracy claim. See README for exact domains, formula witnesses and restrictions.

See README ledger; authored labels are not accepted binary ground truth until checked independently.
